featured.title: Valkaama
featured.description: A Swedish poet and his friend set out on a final journey toward Valkaama, while a parallel search uncovers a dark lie. The creator-hosted 720p film is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0.
featured.attribution: Valkaama, directed and produced by Tim Baumann; story by Hendrik Behnisch and Lynn Gray. Film licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. Thumbnail is a resized still from the film.
